newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends higher vs dlr on yen strength.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends higher vs dlr on yen strength.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed slightly higher against its U.S. counterpart on Tuesday, reflecting the greenback's weakness overseas against the Japanese yen, dealers said.
The local unit ended at T$27.490 against Monday's T$27.495 close. Turnover through dealers was a modest US$176.5 million.
Dealers expected mild month-end demand for the American dollar to keep the local currency from rising too much.
"A stable trend will continue," said one dealer.
A T$27.48-51 range was seen for Wednesday.
